message.content: {"16560_8353800455556": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The chest X-ray (Figure 1a) demonstrates marked tracheomegaly (indicated by arrowheads), multiple well-defined nodular opacities in the right lower lung zone, and increased linear markings (tram-tracking) in the left pulmonary base consistent with bronchiectasis."}, "16560_8353800471706": {"answer": "C", "reason": "The combination of significant tracheomegaly and associated bronchiectasis (linear opacities/nodules) is the hallmark radiographic presentation of Mounier-Kuhn syndrome (tracheobronchomegaly)."}, "16560_8353800483039": {"answer": "E", "reason": "The posteroanterior view confirms tracheomegaly and shows ill-defined opacities in the right lower lobe along with increased linear opacities in the left pulmonary base, which are characteristic findings of cylindrical bronchiectasis associated with this syndrome."}}
